name: LoRa propagation reference values
description: Canonical reference values for the LICHEN propagation model. All values computed from the deterministic log-distance path loss model PL(d) = PL0 + 10*n*log10(d/d0) with PL0=32.44dB, d0=1.0m. Urban (n=2.7) unless otherwise specified. Noise floor = -120 dBm. These are the fixed oracles against which all implementations MUST produce matching output. Shadowing and fading are non-deterministic (seeded RNG) and not part of this fixed-vector set.

vectors.name: path_loss_at_1m
vectors.description: Path loss at reference distance equals PL0 (32.44 dB).

vectors.name: path_loss_at_100m_urban
vectors.description: Path loss at 100m with urban exponent n=2.7. PL = 32.44 + 27*log10(100) = 86.44 dB.

vectors.name: path_loss_at_1000m_urban
vectors.description: Path loss at 1000m with urban exponent n=2.7.

vectors.name: path_loss_at_2000m_urban
vectors.description: Path loss at 2000m with urban exponent n=2.7.

vectors.name: path_loss_at_100m_free_space
vectors.description: Path loss at 100m with free space exponent n=2.0.

vectors.name: capture_threshold
vectors.description: Capture effect threshold: 6.0 dB per Bor et al. 2016.

vectors.name: max_range_sf10_14dbm_urban
